animations.walk: REFERENCE is identity/costume ONLY. Repose this SAME photorealistic adult turtle-man, same exact adult human face, black rectangular glasses, black hair, densely HAIRY human legs, rough green shell, old yellow belly armor, green claw gloves/feet, small grey-blue wing ears and dirty curled tail. Real photography / absurd slightly gross human-turtle meme, NO cartoon/chibi, no cute face, no skin smoothing. All body parts fully visible with 15 percent transparent padding inside EVERY cell. Build EIGHT consecutive animation frames in exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, wide 2:1 sheet. Same character scale, center and foot level, actual transparent alpha background, no ground/shadows/text/labels/borders. ONE smooth action cycle, not unrelated poses. CRITICAL CORRECTION: crawling must involve BOTH ARMS AND BOTH LEGS, visibly changing positions, not just face changes. REMOVE the reference's permanent thumbs-up gesture. BOTH clawed hands rest or reach toward the ground as load-bearing FORELIMBS, like a large awkward four-legged turtle. Low horizontal crouch, torso tilted forward, human face visible in 3/4 side view facing RIGHT, shell prominent above back, hairy knees bent. Animate a full in-place QUADRUPED CRAWLING gait: frame1 left hand forward planted/right leg back; frame2 right hand lifts, elbow bends; frame3 right arm stretches well FORWARD while left leg slides forward; frame4 right palm PLANTS and torso shifts over it; frame5 left palm LIFTS, left elbow bends while right hind foot pushes; frame6 left forearm extends well forward/right knee advances; frame7 left palm PLANTS, weight shifts, opposite foot slides; frame8 returns to nearly frame1 stance. Hands must move by at least 12 percent of body width between planted and reaching phases. Hairy legs visibly alternate and knees flex; shell rocks subtly with weight shifts. No permanently raised hand, no stationary thumb sign, no duplicated limbs. All 8 frames depict continuous functional locomotion with clear arm articulation and planted-hand contact, not 8 almost identical squats.
